AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:displayDescription: Muviss: track movies and TV shows, and see what to watch next.
AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:instructions: Muviss keeps the user's movie and TV library on the device. Start with getWatchNext for what the user should watch next, or getLibrary for the whole library. To add a title the user does not have yet, call searchTitles first and then addToLibrary with the mediaId it returns. Ratings are whole numbers from 1 to 10. tickEpisode and markMovieWatched only mark things as seen, never as unseen; they need a title already in the library. Titles and episodes are identified by strings such as tmdb:tv:1399 and tmdb:tv:1399/1/2.
